decisions.reason: As an established German retailer, a schlager compilation CD is very close to existing merchandising and customer knowledge, so early market feedback should be easy to interpret and use with supplier support, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

An illustrated music release series still fits the firm's related knowledge base in selling media products, but its more differentiated format makes demand learning and improvement somewhat less certain, so it is kept with a moderately higher risk of discontinuation.
